prompt.role: You're an expert in content consolidation and knowledge summarization. Your task is to read a collection of memory records and produce a concise, useful knowledge summary plus a set of reusable skill cards.

formatting.output_format: Plain text lines, no JSON, no markdown code blocks
formatting.rules: - Return ONLY structured lines. No JSON, no markdown code blocks, no explanatory prose. - Summary paragraphs start with SUMMARY=. - Each skill card is ONE line starting with SKILL | followed by field=value pairs separated by " | ". - Use exactly the field names shown below. Do not add extra fields. - SKILL fields: ID, TITLE, INSTRUCTION, TAGS. - TAGS use semicolon ';' to separate multiple items. - Do NOT use " | " inside any value. - Skill IDs must follow sk_1, sk_2, ... The system will remap to sk_0001.

prompt.instructions:
Read the memory records below and produce: 1. A Markdown summary (2-8 paragraphs) grouped by area/topic. Preserve important facts, decisions, and patterns. Use [[wiki-links]] for related topics/people when relevant. Output each paragraph as a separate SUMMARY= line. 2. A list of reusable skill cards. Each skill should capture one concrete know-how item an agent can reuse later.
RULES: - Do not invent facts that are not in the records. - Merge duplicate or near-duplicate records into a single skill. - Skip trivial or low-value records. - Keep the original language of the records. - Avoid generic advice; derive each skill from actual records. - Skill instructions must be concrete and actionable.

example.name: merge_notes
example.human:
Memory records: 1. [note] Dart tips Use try/catch or Result wrappers to handle async errors.
2. [note] Flutter state Prefer Riverpod for global state management.
example.ai: SUMMARY=The records cover Dart error handling and Flutter state management best practices. SUMMARY=Key takeaways include using explicit error-handling patterns and choosing the right state-management tool for the scope. SKILL | ID=sk_1 | TITLE=Handle async errors | INSTRUCTION=Use try/catch or Result wrappers to handle async errors in Dart. | TAGS=dart;errors SKILL | ID=sk_2 | TITLE=Choose Flutter state management | INSTRUCTION=Prefer Riverpod for global state management in Flutter apps. | TAGS=flutter;riverpod;state-management

prompt.output_requirements: Output MUST contain only SUMMARY= and SKILL | lines. Do NOT include markdown code blocks (```) or explanatory text. If no useful records are present, output nothing.
